label: Launch-on-shift
subgoals: Shift once more after loading the first vector
Load the scan-in bit into the first flop and shift the rest along
Switch scan enable to capture within one at-speed cycle

label: Launch-on-capture
subgoals: Drop scan enable after loading the first vector
Evaluate each flop's next-state function of the first vector
Capture the launch state with the first at-speed clock

label: Choosing between them
subgoals: Prefer launch-on-shift for coverage when scan enable can be timed
Prefer launch-on-capture when scan enable must stay slow
Generate the launch and capture pulses with an on-chip clock controller
